company_summary: Perplexity AI, Inc. is a company that develops a search engine and partners with top language models to create a user-friendly interface for enterprises. Their core product is a search engine with a fast and affordable API that includes search and citations. Recently, the company was mentioned in relation to a startup competition where participants must have an active Perplexity subscription to enter. The company was founded in August 2022 by a team of four engineers, but the current funding stage and team size are not specified.
